parsed.scene_description: A spacious indoor area with floor-to-ceiling windows on the left. A large red curved wall dominates the right foreground. In the background, people sit at tables near a spiral shelving unit. The floor is reflective.

objects.label: red curved wall
objects.observation: Large, smooth, red surface curving from right foreground into mid-ground. No visible supports or attachments to other structures.

objects.label: spiral shelving unit
objects.observation: Multi-tiered structure with circular shelves containing books or items. Located in background against a wall.

objects.label: table
objects.observation: Round table surface visible in mid-ground where people are seated. No legs or supports clearly discernible.

objects.label: chair
objects.observation: Transparent plastic chair with blue seat located in foreground left. No visible attachment points or supports.

objects.label: window frame
objects.observation: Vertical black frames dividing large glass panes along the left wall. No visible structural supports.
